sentence: This project studies how chromatin factors, epigenetic states and nuclear organization affect DNA copy gains.
This project builds an ultrasound-based guidance system to lower traumatic lumbar puncture rates in pediatric patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
This project studies how Zika virus changes myeloid cell responses so that T cells can attack glioblastoma tumors.
This project studies how a high fat diet pushes clonal hematopoiesis toward blood cancers such as acute myeloid leukemia.
This project uses protein engineering and functional testing to target acid-sensing ion channels, which are membrane proteins found in the brain and body.
This project supports cancer researchers with data analysis and computational methods for using omics data.
This project studies the cell behaviors needed for normal upper lip development to understand cleft lip.
This project supports basic and translational research on HIV cure through immunology, pharmacology and bioinformatics services.
This project tests whether T cell therapies work better against tumors when the T cells resist exhaustion.
This project studies pediatric asthma endotypes to improve diagnostic methods and describe their clinical characteristics.
This project uses electronic medical records to identify children with chronic primary pain and find what predicts their health and pain outcomes.
This project uses brain recordings in a mouse model to understand how dopamine causes the involuntary movements of tardive dyskinesia.
This project works to improve asthma care in urban children and find ways to prevent asthma.
This project studies how Growth Hormone signaling changes neuroimmune communication in neonatal inflammatory pain.
This project uses proteomic approaches to study what causes restless legs syndrome and to find biomarkers that help diagnose it.
This project tests how well bromodomain and extra-terminal motif inhibitors work against solitary fibrous tumors.
This project studies how mitochondrial fragmentation changes metabolism in colorectal cancer cells that grow in the gut and liver.
This project tests whole-genome sequencing to improve genetic profiling and risk assessment for patients with myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project studies how insecticide exposure affects the brain in adolescents who work in agriculture and in a mouse model.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms behind neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental diseases using mouse models with disrupted lysine acetylation.
